it.about_tagline: Prototipa oggetti di scena e ambienti XR immersivi con volumi primitivi, superfici mappate ed esportazioni rapide per i dispositivi.
it.about_scene_purpose: XReate è uno sketchbook nel browser per impostare prop, scenografie e prototipi spaziali per videogiochi ed esperienze XR immersive. È dedicato a Federico Torre, il cui lavoro nel cinema, nel teatro e nella scenografia rendeva vivo lo spazio prima ancora che venisse costruito.
it.about_agentic_coding: Questa web app è stata concepita, progettata e iterata con l’Agentic Coding: direzione umana e revisione critica guidano un processo di implementazione assistito dall’AI.
it.about_uv_scope: Gli strumenti UV sono astrazioni didattiche semplificate per comprendere come si comportano superfici, texture e relazioni spaziali.
it.about_limits: I limiti sono intenzionali: rendono leggibili costruzione, scala e iterazione. XReate non sostituisce un software di modellazione 3D professionale.
it.about_blender: Per modellazione avanzata, animazione, rigging, materiali o pipeline di produzione, usa strumenti dedicati come Blender.
it.about_federico: Federico Torre è stato un attore italiano il cui lavoro ha attraversato teatro, cinema, radio e televisione. La sua formazione a New York al Theater Lab e la sua attenzione ai corpi nello spazio continuano a ispirare l’amore di questo progetto per la scenografia e i mondi vissuti.
it.doodle_step1_help: Carica un’immagine di riferimento da ricalcare, oppure continua su una tela vuota.
it.doodle_mode_caption_polygon: Disegna una forma chiusa: verrà estrusa in un solido 3D.
it.doodle_mode_caption_mirror: Disegna la metà sinistra di un profilo sull’asse: verrà specchiata in un solido 3D simmetrico.

__fallback_en.doodle_error_extrude_failed: Extrude failed. Check the polygon and try again.

__fallback_en.doodle_error_too_many_points: Too many points. Simplify the polygon (max 256).
__fallback_en.doodle_mirror_canvas_hint:
Draw only on the left half.
Move: drag the image to align.
Draw: click to add points.
Apply auto-fills (no need to click the first point).
Apply revolves into 3D.

Good practice:
- Draw in one pass from bottom to top (or top to bottom) without backtracking.
- For a flat base: start near the axis, step left on the same level, then go up.
__fallback_en.doodle_step1_help: Load a reference image to trace over, or skip to draw on a blank canvas.
__fallback_en.doodle_step2_help: Click to add polygon points. Click near the first point to close the polygon. Shift+drag to pan. Scroll to zoom.
__fallback_en.doodle_step2_help_mirror: Draw the profile on the left half. Apply revolves it into 3D. Use Draw/Move. Shift+drag to pan vertically. Wheel to zoom.
__fallback_en.doodle_mode_caption_polygon: Draw a closed shape — it will be extruded into a 3D solid.
__fallback_en.doodle_mode_caption_mirror: Draw the left half of a profile on the axis — it will be mirrored into a symmetric 3D solid.
__fallback_en.doodle_phone_unavailable: Doodle needs a larger drawing canvas. It is available on tablet and desktop.
__fallback_en.doodle_tool_move_disabled: Load a reference image first to align it.

__fallback_en.uv_texel_density_help: Texel density describes how many texture pixels cover one unit of surface area. Higher values mean sharper results at close range.

__fallback_en.uv_hint_planar: Planar: projection is a flat snapshot. Curved surfaces will stretch near the edges.

__fallback_en.about_tagline: Prototype scene props and immersive XR environments with primitive volumes, mapped surfaces, and rapid device-ready exports.
__fallback_en.about_scene_purpose: XReate is a browser-native sketchbook for blocking out props, scenography, and spatial prototypes for videogames and immersive XR experiences. It is dedicated to Federico Torre, whose work in cinema, theatre, and scenography made space feel alive before it was built.
__fallback_en.about_agentic_coding: This web app was conceived, designed, and iterated with Agentic Coding: human direction and critical review guide an AI-assisted implementation process.
__fallback_en.about_uv_scope: The UV tools are simplified educational abstractions for learning how surfaces, textures, and spatial relationships behave.
__fallback_en.about_limits: Constraints make construction, scale, and iteration legible. XReate is not a replacement for professional 3D modelling software.
__fallback_en.about_blender: For advanced modelling, animation, rigging, materials, or production pipelines, use dedicated tools such as Blender.
__fallback_en.about_federico: Federico Torre was an Italian actor whose work crossed theatre, cinema, radio, and television. His formation in New York at the Theater Lab and his attention to bodies in space continue to inform this project’s love of scenography and lived worlds.
__fallback_en.aria_tree_up: Move volume up in the composition
__fallback_en.aria_tree_down: Move volume down in the composition
__fallback_en.uv_mode_help: Projection modes control how a 2D image is wrapped around a 3D surface. Try all four to find the best fit for your shape.
__fallback_en.uv_panel_hint: Select a volume to configure how textures project onto its surface.
